labels.detected: FUSE recognizes the input or artifact type, but this alone means no security analyzer completed.
labels.basic: Documented native checks ran over selected file types without resolving the effective product build.
labels.supported: The named input, tool versions, operating systems, and positive, negative, and boundary cases have regression coverage.
labels.partial: Some useful stages completed while an applicable stage was skipped, unavailable, or failed.
labels.experimental: An opt-in adapter is available, but its scope or output contract is not stable enough for a broad support claim.
labels.planned: No analysis capability is available yet.
labels.unsupported: FUSE did not select a security analyzer for this input type.

capabilities.label: basic
capabilities.scope: Seven native rules over selected source and configuration files.
limitations: No build resolution
No runtime or device validation

capabilities.label: basic
capabilities.scope: Generic native rules plus explicit boot-image validation setting checks.
limitations: Source-only settings are conditional
Generated build inspection requires explicit --build-dir
Does not prove the selected build is released

capabilities.label: basic
capabilities.scope: Generic native rules over the expanded Zephyr file profile.
limitations: Generated build metadata requires explicit --build-dir
Does not run Zephyr hardenconfig
Does not prove the selected build is released

capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Reads bounded generated sdkconfig metadata, records selected sdkconfig and defaults provenance, and applies initial boot-validation checks to the selected configuration.
limitations: Does not invoke the build system
Does not prove that the selected build is shipped
Does not evaluate Kconfig dependencies

capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Reads bounded generated Kconfig metadata and can import the selected build's JSON report from Zephyr hardenconfig.
limitations: Does not invoke west or the build system
Hardening results require an explicit report produced by Zephyr
Does not prove that the selected build is shipped

capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Merges a bounded extra_configs graph and inventories declared environments, boards, platforms, frameworks, source directories, source-filter declarations, and selected defaults without invoking PlatformIO.
limitations: Does not evaluate variable substitutions, project scripts, or source filters into compiled files
Missing or unsafe includes produce partial coverage
Does not build or test any environment
Does not compare environment-specific compiled output

capabilities.input: Project tree and common build-output directories
capabilities.label: detected
capabilities.scope: Records candidate paths, extensions, and sizes without opening binary contents.
limitations: An extension does not prove a file is firmware
No digest or format validation is performed
The listed path set is bounded

capabilities.label: basic
capabilities.scope: Checks exact workflow-level and job-level write-all permission scalars, counts recognized non-SHA action references, reports obvious floating branch refs, and flags an exact pull_request_target plus actions/checkout pull-request-head-ref pattern.
limitations: Only simple write-all and pull-request-head-ref YAML forms are checked
Version-tag refs are counted but are not findings
The pull_request_target check does not infer whether later steps build or execute checked-out content
Not a general YAML, expression, permission-inheritance, or event-taint analyzer
Findings describe workflow supply-chain candidates, not device vulnerabilities

capabilities.input: Selected or uniquely detected KiCad XML netlist
capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Reports named debug/programming nets connected to connector-designator or connector-like components.
limitations: Does not validate PCB routing, physical access, population state, or debug-port configuration
Does not export a netlist or invoke KiCad

capabilities.label: detected
capabilities.scope: Indexes translation units and compiler families as bounded metadata.
limitations: Compiler commands and project code are never executed
No compiler or semantic C/C++ analyzer is run

capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Optional, bounded inventory of resolved component versions and dependency edges.
limitations: Requires the optional PyYAML extra
Does not prove a resolved component was built or shipped
Manifest freshness is not verified

capabilities.input: Embedded Linux source, service, and recipe files
capabilities.label: basic
capabilities.scope: Generic native rules over the expanded embedded Linux file profile.
limitations: Does not resolve the selected image build or installed package set

capabilities.label: detected
capabilities.scope: Recognizes the supplied inventory and records it as the analysis target.
limitations: Advisory matching requires OSV-Scanner

capabilities.input: CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM with advisory lookup
capabilities.label: basic
capabilities.scope: Matches identified package versions to OSV advisories.
limitations: Does not prove package inclusion in a shipped device or vulnerable code reachability

capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Optional signature identification only.
limitations: No extraction, filesystem analysis, or execution
Default 512 MiB input cap is configurable up to 2 GiB

capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Optional Gitleaks history scan with redacted finding metadata.
limitations: Requires Git and Gitleaks
Shallow history is partial
Does not validate whether a matched credential is still usable

capabilities.input: Schematics, PCB, fabrication, BOM, CAD, netlist, and HDL files
capabilities.label: detected
capabilities.scope: Filename-based presence inventory with category counts and paths.
limitations: Presence-only filename detection does not assess hardware security
KiCad netlist parsing is a separate candidate analyzer
Detailed BOM parsing requires the explicit hardware.hbom-import capability

capabilities.input: Explicit CSV or TSV hardware BOM
capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Imports allow-listed component columns and exports a CycloneDX 1.6 hardware inventory.
limitations: Does not validate part specifications or assess circuit security
Import is limited to UTF-8 CSV and TSV

capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Attaches reviewed status to exact product, package PURL, and advisory matches while retaining findings.
limitations: VEX signatures are not authenticated
Imported review does not change finding severity or fail thresholds
Only exact PURL and advisory matches are applied

capabilities.input: In-toto SLSA provenance statement and firmware image
capabilities.label: experimental
capabilities.scope: Compares a supplied subject SHA-256 with the selected firmware image and records claimed builder metadata.
limitations: Signature and builder trust are not verified
Does not validate build policy or provenance completeness

capabilities.input: Physical device or controlled lab evidence
capabilities.label: planned
capabilities.scope: Physical device testing is outside the current FUSE workflow.
limitations: Not performed by the current FUSE scanner
